reason: My customer list is my whole business, and I don't know who you are or where my customers' numbers end up. I already paid for one app my boys dropped in a few weeks, so I'm not paying again on a promise.
objection: Is my customer list safe with you, or will it go to a competitor or some marketing company? And even if it is safe, my technicians will stop pressing the button after two weeks, like last time.
would_change_my_mind: Another Chennai shop owner I know telling me his technicians are still using it after three months, and something in writing that my customer data stays mine and is not shared.
